name: Mark Bateman
role: Justice of the peace at Mandan
bio: Mark Bateman was a justice at Mandan who heard evidence in a death inquiry in April 1884 and, with Justice Collins, discharged the Marquis de Mores in the Luffsey killing on the ground of self-defense. At the Marquis's September 1885 trial at Bismarck he testified about that earlier examination.
